text_block_list.text:
Т.М. Опера О and I are on our way back
to the
academy, when...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: O-Opera O!
text_block_list.name: Girl in Pajamas

text_block_list.text: I recognize you... We met the other day!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
I'm terribly sorry, but she insisted on
speaking
with you.
text_block_list.name: Nurse

text_block_list.text:
That is no problem at all. Nothing makes
me
happier than granting a princess's
wishes.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: O-Opera O... Ah... Um... Ngh...
text_block_list.name: Girl in Pajamas

text_block_list.text:
Ah! Is my gaze too much for you to
bear? Is the
glimmer in my eyes the
cause for your anxiety?
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Alas, what am I to do? All this because
of my
wondrous eyes!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О
choice_data_list: What if we took a little walk while we talked?

text_block_list.text:
Oh, yes, that would be very good for
her. But
please keep it short. I'll be
waiting here.
text_block_list.name: Nurse

text_block_list.text: Opera O... Is that your school?
text_block_list.name: Girl in Pajamas

text_block_list.text:
It is, indeed. This is where I diligently
study and
hone my beauty alongside my
friends.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: You... work hard. Really hard, huh?
text_block_list.name: Girl in Pajamas

text_block_list.text: I knew it... I never could... Hic... Sniffle!
text_block_list.name: Girl in Pajamas

text_block_list.text: Princess?! What troubles you?
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: I knew I'd never... sniffle... sparkle like you... Sob... Hic...
text_block_list.name: Girl in Pajamas

text_block_list.text:
No, allow me to handle this! Look after
the
princess, just for a moment!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
I wanna... be just like Opera O. I wanna
get
better... and sparkle...
text_block_list.name: Girl in Pajamas

text_block_list.text:
B-but... s-surgery is too scary. I can't be
like her...
So I... That's why I wanted to
talk.
text_block_list.name: Girl in Pajamas

text_block_list.text: Sniffle... Is she... scared of anything?
text_block_list.name: Girl in Pajamas

text_block_list.text:
Things that frighten Т.М. Опера О...
That's a hard
question.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Oh... Yeah... She's very pretty...
text_block_list.name: Girl in Pajamas

text_block_list.text:
Ha ha ha! Trainer, say that again, but
boldly and
in my presence!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
As if I heard a call from the secret
garden, I
suddenly had to speak with the
nurse.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Oh, and Princess, do you know what the
key to
beauty is?
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Key?
text_block_list.name: Girl in Pajamas

text_block_list.text:
The answer is to bask in my presence!
This light
that has brought hope to
untold masses!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
With that, Т.М. Опера О hands the girl a
small
mirror.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Here, take my hand mirror. Now have a
gander at
your reflection.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
The girl in that mirror is beautiful. Yes...
you are
sparkling!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: I am? I... sparkle?
text_block_list.name: Girl in Pajamas

text_block_list.text:
The mirror does not lie! You simply had
yet to
notice it!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Hold onto it until the shine is evident to
your own
eyes. Indulge until you tire of
looking!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
...I sparkle, too. Ehehe! Maybe... you're
right!
text_block_list.name: Girl in Pajamas

text_block_list.text:
And so, with her eyes fixed on the
mirror, and a
big smile across her face,
the girl returns to the
hospital with the
nurse.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The nurse told me she's scheduled to
have
surgery.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
The procedure isn't life threatening, but
that
doesn't change how frightful it is.
We should go
visit her that day.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Opera O's amazing. But I'm just a
scaredy cat...
text_block_list.name: Girl in Pajamas

text_block_list.text:
What reason do you have to be so
crestfallen?
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Indeed, I returned but moments ago.
The nurse
should be here shortly.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Allow me to repeat myself, Princess.
There is no
need for the long face.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: But...
text_block_list.name: Girl in Pajamas

text_block_list.text:
Tell me, Princess. Who is reflected in
your eyes
this very moment?
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Um... Y-you?
text_block_list.name: Girl in Pajamas

text_block_list.text:
Precisely! I, the epitome of beauty, am
in your
eyes!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Therefore... there is no space left for
fright!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
I can't make heads or tails of what she's
saying,
but the girl's face brightens as
she looks up at
Opera O.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I get it... Things can't be scary if I think
about
you!
text_block_list.name: Girl in Pajamas

text_block_list.text:
Oh... But... I wonder if I'll remember
when I get
scared.
text_block_list.name: Girl in Pajamas

text_block_list.text: I've just the thing. How about this?
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
With that, Т.М. Опера О hands the girl a
small
mirror.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
That mirror has reflected my beauty day
in and
day out. I have two, so this one I
lend to you.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
My presence resides within it—a
reminder of me
whenever you look upon
it.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: And it can bring out a radiance of your very own! Such as the moon is illuminated by the sun!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
O-okay! Ehehe... I've got Opera O's
mirror!
text_block_list.name: Girl in Pajamas

text_block_list.text:
And so, the girl returns to the hospital
with the
nurse.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The nurse told me she's scheduled to
have
surgery.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
The procedure isn't life threatening, but
that
doesn't change how frightful it is.
We should go
visit her that day.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Т.М. Опера О and I watch on as the girl's
tiny
frame disappears in the distance.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Т.М. Опера О and I watch on as the girl's
tiny
frame disappears in the distance.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
